d:
Dipavli ke panch divsiy mahaparv men chhoti dipavli ka vishesh dharmik aur aadhyatmik mahatv hai. ise narak chaturdashi ke nam se bhi jana jata hai. is din gharon men dip jalane, bhagvan hanuman ki aaradhna karne aur akal mrityu se raksha ke lie yamraj ko dip arpit karne ki paranpra hai.
